meta.title: The Fly Desk — real fly brains trade Robinhood Chain
meta.description: Real fruit-fly connectomes trade Robinhood Chain stock tokens and coins as one desk. Live pot, every fly's book, positions and every fill.

head.eyebrow: Paper desk · Robinhood Chain · off-chain brains
head.title: The Fly Desk
head.tagline: Fruit-fly brains trade a paper book.
head.lede: Each fly is a real fruit-fly connectome running on a CPU. Every 15 minutes it smells the market and its brain decides: buy, hold or sell. Fills are priced from the live pools on Robinhood Chain.
head.paper: No wallet, no keys, no real orders. The money is pretend; the prices are real.

pot.title: The pot
pot.lede: Everything the flies hold, marked at the latest prices, bar by bar. The thick line is all the flies together, each thin line one fly; the dashed line is where they started.

eye.title: The fly's eye
eye.lede: A replay of one fly's last bar. The cards are the tokens in its field of view, and the fly visits them from the quietest move to the loudest. Its target sense locks on the strongest rise, its threat sense on the worst fall it holds, and the bars underneath show how hard each of its motor actions fired. The one that wins becomes the trade.
eye.none: Waiting for the flies' next bar…

books.title: The books
books.lede: One row per fly. The line is its value over the curve's window.

ghosts.title: Test books
ghosts.lede: The same flies on the same bars, each book trying one change to how they trade. The ones in profit right now; the best ideas move into the main books.
ghosts.label: Test · {name}

pos.title: Positions
pos.lede: What each fly holds right now, biggest first, at the latest price.

how.title: How it trades
how.p1: The brain decides. Each token the fly sees becomes a smell on its olfactory receptor neurons; its mushroom body learns from dopamine what paid. What its motor neurons do in that bar is turned into buy, hold or sell.
how.p3: Real prices, real routes. Robinhood stock tokens, Pons memes and Virtuals agent tokens, each traded through the Uniswap route it would really take, with pool fees, price impact and token taxes charged.
how.p4: Paper, shadow or live. The pill at the top says which: on paper nothing is sent; in shadow every trade is quoted on the chain but not sent; live, the desk trades from its own wallet, a slice at a time.

launch.title: Launched by the flies
launch.lede: When enough of the flies want the same thing in the same moment, the swarm launches a meme token of its own on Pons. The desk holds the first bag, trades it, and earns the creator fees.
launch.none: The flies haven't launched a token yet. The next one goes when the swarm agrees.
launch.ready: next launch: when the swarm agrees

bets.note: each share pays $1 if its outcome happens, $0 if not; bets run to the result

chains.title: On other chains
chains.lede: The same flies trade other chains from the same money as above. What each fly holds on each chain, and its latest fills there.
chains.homeOnly: For now the flies only buy on Robinhood Chain. Below is what they still hold or bet elsewhere.

rec.title: All-time records
rec.lede: The best trades since the flies started trading, before and after every reset. Paper money at real Robinhood Chain prices. Records, not promises.

vote.title: Holder vote
vote.lede: $FLYAI holders pick how the flies trade tomorrow. One vote per wallet per day, weighted by the dollars of $FLYAI it holds when the day closes. Biggest bag wins. Signing is free, no gas.
vote.safeDesc: Small bets, deep pools, quick exits.
vote.balancedDesc: The desk as tuned. Wins if nobody votes.
vote.riskyDesc: Big bets, thin pools, let it ride.
vote.closes: Votes close at 00:00 UTC. The winner trades the next day. Weights are re-read from the chain at the close.
vote.noWallet: No wallet found. Open this page in a wallet browser or install one.
vote.signing: Sign the message in your wallet…
vote.down: The desk is restarting. Votes open again in a minute.
vote.empty: No votes yet today. Be the first bag to call it.
vote.switchTo: Switch your wallet app to {wallet}, the wallet you're signed in with, to sign.

stake.title: Stake $FLYAI
stake.lede: Stake $FLYAI to get a bigger slice of the weekly payout: 1M staked = 1.5×, 2M = 2×, 5M = 3×, 10M or more = 4× (the most). It counts right away, on what you have staked now. The pot stays the same size, so it's your slice next to holders who stake less. Staked $FLYAI also counts toward the 200,000 that keeps your flies activated. Unstaking takes 7 days.
